Every one still gave the alert and the card list. The card's own test file also passes (264 tests).
- **Fewer alerts before vs. after on past session records — FAIL (unable).** The card records 544 crossings before and 57 after. The session records the executor replayed, on the user's machine, aren't available here, so I couldn't reproduce those counts.
- **Reporting contract — FAIL (read).** The work log has only its header and no executor report, so there are no "Decisions made" or "Work not done" fields to judge. Two things those fields would have had to cover: dropping the earlier card W-00000311's rule that outside paths are still reported, and editing `.stage/work/active.md`, which isn't in the card's listed scope.
